blind.description: A stylized gothic/fantasy wooden lectern featuring an octagonal molded base, a carved central column, and a slanted desktop supporting a large open book. The book has thick cream-colored parchment pages, gold corner protectors, and a hanging red ribbon bookmark. A small brass candleholder with a short white candle sits on the upper-right ledge of the desk. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted stylized edge highlights.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden desk surface displaying an open two-page book with cream pages and a central fold, plus a small circular candle and dish on the upper right. The pedestal column is occluded beneath the bookstand.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly chest-high to the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide across the reading desk.
